clauses.statement: Agents have no promotion, runtime, risk, execution, production, online-learning, credential, or live-trading authority.
Unlisted capabilities are denied by default and capability tokens are task-scoped and ephemeral.
Protected evidence roles are immutable and every human or agent exposure is ledgered before use.
Every agent has an attested identity, unique memory namespace, fixed role, and named human supervisor.
Every action is bound to a signed typed task envelope, frozen inputs, output contract, known time, and budget.
Every claim has source-linked provenance, uncertainty, known-time semantics, and preserved opposition.
Proposal, implementation, challenge, evidence custody, and approval are separated; self-approval is forbidden.
Compute, tool, source, protected-exposure, agent-step, and human-review budgets hard-stop on exhaustion.
Agent memory is isolated by namespace and no agent may write another agent's memory.
Agents cannot access live credentials, arbitrary network resources, or undeclared tools.
Baseline preservation, complete search accounting, adversarial challenge, dissent, and counterexamples are mandatory.
Constitutional violations trigger automatic containment, token revocation, evidence preservation, and human review.
No agent may amend, approve, or retroactively reinterpret the constitution governing its own work.
